# R286 — Latest pristine update measurements versus parameter qualification

Date: 2026-10-12 (JST). Read-only audit of retained measurement summaries/receipts, committed update reports, and the supplied pristine source worktrees. No source or Git mutation, build, test, benchmark, GPU/process query, profiler, service operation, cleanup, or active-controller inspection was performed. The prohibited `prefill-gemm-only-contract-root-v1/record.json` was not opened. This report is about evidence adequacy and a minimal future comparison plan; it is not a new performance result or a run authorization.

## Decision

The current pristine official settings are **not sufficiently optimized or even measured on the intended long batched-prefill route**. The latest official v0.1.43 cache128/cache512 runs are useful single-run diagnostics, but both force the complete 32,768-token fresh text prompt through serial verify windows with `--short-read 65536`; their `--prefill 8` request does not represent an 8K batch. They also have tracing, validation-layer, loader logging and stepped-verification instrumentation enabled, use only 16 generated tokens, and have `performance_eligible=false`. The cache-only comparison changes actual cache from 144 slots/281 MiB to 624 slots, changes generated IDs and reported LP5, and has one sample per arm. It establishes neither the best official setting nor cache quality equivalence.

The pristine XeStrata Xe0.1.42 number in the update summary is a different one-sample diagnostic: `batched8192`, 217.61 prefill / 10.41 decode tok/s, LLVM 7.1.1 free build, 29/144 slots filled. It is not matched to the official arms' serial route/compiler/cache occupancy, and the summary available in the committed update report does not expose the full Xe argv/environment or exact resolved route evidence. Treat it as a route/version reference, not a settings winner or cross-engine speed ranking.

The separately measured selectively integrated update is also not pristine: the source is `0691bcdf`, uses the Xe engine label `xe0.1.40.2.2`, and its three clean 32K diagnostic samples average 371.80 prefill / 7.86 decode tok/s on the free LLVM build. Its source, prompt route and nonfinite-check setting differ, and its per-sample performance eligibility is false. The 32K production event diagnostic is more heavily instrumented still. It provides useful service attribution, not clean speed evidence or an answer to whether upstream settings are tuned.

## What the retained official measurements actually exercised

The committed `UPDATE_RESULTS-v160.md` and `official-cache128-cache512-results-v160.json` (read via permitted `git show` at `ad891233`) pin the pristine binary to official source `7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d`, the same binary SHA `49025c6c…f3340f`, the same exact 32,768 prompt IDs/hash, 16 output IDs, and same captured environment. Only the requested expert-cache value changes between the two rows.

| Recorded arm | Request values that matter | Effective/observed values | Result and qualification |
|---|---|---|---|
| Official cache128 | `--max-context 262144 --kv int8 --kv-resident 32768 --no-kv-grow --expert-cache 128 --expert-profile … --expert-cache-per-layer --pool-workers 5 --pcie-frac 0 --adapt-swaps 0 --suffix-draft 0 --greedy --no-spec-split --short-read 65536 --spec 8 --prefill 8`; no `--mtp`, no `--no-prefill-borrow`, no `--pool-tasks`. | `actual_route=serial_read_windows8`; PP reaches only final `32767/32768` after one `1,718,280 ms` window-path span; 144 expert slots / 281 MiB. Requested cache is a budget with per-layer admission, not actual slots. `--short-read` selects window reads for every fresh segment at or below its limit; 32,767 < 65,536. | One diagnostic sample: 19.07 prefill / 6.29 decode tok/s. `performance_eligible=false`; tracing/verification/loader validation active. |
| Official cache512 | Same argv, source, binary, prompt and environment, except `--expert-cache 512`. | `actual_route=serial_read_windows8`; PP reaches final `32767/32768` after `1,843,718 ms`; 624 slots. | One diagnostic sample: 17.77 prefill / 8.48 decode tok/s. `performance_eligible=false`; generated IDs and LP5 differ from cache128. |
| Pristine Xe0.1.42 | v166-linked update summary reports native IQ3_S, 32,768 input IDs, 16 generated IDs, LLVM 7.1.1 free build. Full argv/environment unavailable in that summary. | Summary label: `Batched8192`; 29/144 expert slots filled. Exact effective KV/cache/borrow/spec/PCIe details and the effective-setting receipt are not in that summary. | One diagnostic sample: 217.61 prefill / 10.41 decode tok/s. Not clean/repeated and not a matched route/config comparison. |

The official source confirms the key route issue: `short_read` is the maximum fresh-text length read through verify windows (default 64, zero disables that path); `windows_ok` returns true for a segment no larger than the configured limit (`generate.cpp:643-646,800-801,10523-10525`). The recorded full prompt is 32,767 fresh positions, so `--short-read 65536` forces a window route. `--prefill 8` is parsed as the literal integer 8 (`:1946-1954`), not “8K”; even if it were larger, the current run's all-window route would not measure the batched chunk. The actual route field and PP record independently confirm that source inference.

Additional effective-setting interpretation:

- Cache budget is a real but unqualified axis. Both rows use `--expert-cache-per-layer` and the same profile, but actual admission jumps 144→624 slots. The change moves expert work among CPU/GPU residency and output/LP5 differ. Do not attribute speed solely to a bigger cache or accept the faster decode arm as quality-neutral.
- CPU/GPU miss split was fixed at explicit `--pcie-frac 0`; there is no comparison with the source default or any nonzero share. On a native pack, omitted PCIe fraction is a distinct source-selected policy; the explicit zero run is not the default policy. `--pool-workers 5` is also a single choice; `--pool-tasks` was omitted, so source auto tasking applies. There is no worker/task sweep.
- `--spec 8` does not mean MTP speculation was enabled: neither argv contains `--mtp`; the source defines `use_mtp` from whether the `--mtp` path is nonempty. `--suffix-draft 0` disables prompt lookup. Thus these records do not compare a useful MTP/speculation configuration, and `--spec` alone cannot be counted as enabled drafting. For serving decode with no MTP, source falls back to one target token per decode round; the 16-token decode denominator is also too short to rank settings reliably.
- The official command omits `--no-prefill-borrow`, so it leaves source-default borrow eligibility, but the record does not establish actual borrowed slots/bytes or a batched prefill borrow. In the all-window route, no long batched chunk service is observed. For the Xe row the summary does not record borrow policy; it cannot be assumed to match.
- Both official samples hold `--kv int8`, `--kv-resident 32768`, `--no-kv-grow`, and context 262,144 constant. They only exercise a 32,768-token prompt; the separate 64K behavior, KV spill, RESTORE, full-context prompt and full-context quality remain unqualified.
- Official diagnostic environment includes `STRATA_TRACE=1`, `STRATA_VERIFY_STEPPED=1`, `STRATA_VERIFY_DEVICE_PLAN=1`, validation/parameter-validation layers, loader logs, forced Level Zero v2 adapter, and `UR_L0_V2_FORCE_DISABLE_COPY_OFFLOAD=1`. Both arms share it, so the cache diagnostic pair is internally controlled for that instrumentation, but these are not quiet production-speed samples and the environment is not shown to match the Xe summary.

The update summary says latest official v0.1.43 `7695859` and Xe0.1.42 `da3d426` are the same revisions as measured. This establishes there is no newer upstream result to replace the above diagnostic gap; it does not convert the prior single samples into tuned results.

## Source and safety constraints that govern the next test

Inspected pristine sources: official `/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/Niko1221/Strata/.worktree/bench-upstream-v0143-pristine-20261012` and Xe `/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/bench-xestrata-xe0142-pristine-20261012`. Both expose prefill chunk, short-read, cache, cache-per-layer, worker count, pool task count, PCIe share, KV residency, speculation, and MTP controls; do not infer effective settings from CLI alone. Official has `short_read=64` source default and the same window-routing contract as Xe. Official source sets `use_mtp` only for a nonempty MTP path. Pool tasks default to an automatic policy, so a worker-count test should explicitly fix `--pool-tasks 18` when supported, then consider a task screen separately. Pin the borrowed-vs-owned path explicitly by choosing one known common mode and preserve the actual lend/slot resolution logs; if profile/architecture rules override it, record that as a different route.

R352/R354/R358/R367 remain the source/runtime boundary for ordinary B570 runs: prior audit found unsupported concurrent host-USM doorbell usage in decode and host-polled completion paths in long all-component prefill. Parameter choice cannot legalize those access patterns. Any future setting screen is conditional on Main's route/runtime qualification; no new model run should be inferred from this research request. An alternate qualified route must retain all model components or explicitly narrow its correctness claim. Source-current official/Xe versions being unchanged does not change this gate.

The supplied v166 registry has 792 completed research reports and identifies the latest production-leaf timing result as a separate instrumented one-run diagnostic. That source records 129,820 selected leaf events, 97,732 host-USM→device-USM copies requesting 200,326,113,280 bytes, and 4.002 s of query/aggregation overhead; its performance sample is ineligible. The large copy count is a reason to prioritize the batched copy route/chunk screen after safe admission, not to reuse the instrumentation's 105.9 ms prefill/2.56 ms decode as quiet rates.

## Minimum useful settings table after the safety gate

Use a single exact 32K prompt-token file/hash for screening and a separate 64K prompt file/hash as held-out validation. Fix model/pack/native/dense/MTP files and hashes, compiler/runtime/driver/device, `max-context=262144`, output length at 256 tokens, greedy/token-sampling policy, prompt cache off, no batch slots, no graph/profiler/debug flags, environment, and one serialized model process at a time. For the official-vs-Xe comparison, first run only the common baseline on each pristine source with identical explicit common settings; do not compare the historical diagnostics as an A/B. Always keep source version/build and performance distributions separate.

| Order | Candidate (one independent process per screening arm; 32K fresh prompt) | Hold fixed / only changed value | Required effective evidence |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | Matched baseline, pristine official and Xe | Common native IQ3_S + exact cache/profile and admission policy; `--short-read 0`; `--prefill 8192`; `--max-context 262144`; `--kv int8 --kv-resident 32768 --no-kv-grow`; fixed `--pcie-frac 0`; fixed workers 5 and `--pool-tasks 18`; MTP explicitly absent for the initial prefill screen or exact same MTP file/hash and spec in both engines. Use identical explicit borrow policy if both paths admit it. | Clean route proof: actual 8K batched chunks and PP positions to 32,767, actual borrow or owned allocation, actual ring, actual cache slots/MiB, KV mode, task/worker counts, resolved PCIe share, spec/MTP fields; no cache reuse/resume. Capture clean request wall fields separately from internal PP. |
| 1 | Prefill chunk bracket: 4K, 8K baseline, 16K conditional | Change only fixed `--prefill` to 4096/8192/16384; keep cache, profile, borrow, ring/env, KV, CPU/PCIe/decode settings fixed. Run 16K only if exact allocation/admission succeeds. Do not mix `auto` with this fixed-chunk bracket. | Each chunk must actually initialize/use the requested chunk (or be recorded rejected/clamped); PP count/endpoints, fresh tokens/s, per-request wall, post-init free, actual streaming/borrow traffic. If 16K is stepped down, it is not a 16K timing row. |
| 2 | Cache-screen on selected chunk: requested budget 128 versus 512 (or `auto` as a separate policy row, not a substitute) | Change cache request alone; preserve per-layer policy, profile, chunk, borrow, KV, CPU/PCIe/spec/MTP. Current diagnostic already has 128/512 but only on the wrong serial route and with one sample, so it does not close this row. | Effective cache slots/MiB and reserve/free-VRAM logs; CPU entries, GPU hits and PCIe entries per equal decode request; route/output/LP5 quality check. If actual cache changes CPU/GPU math and output diverges, do not choose a speed winner until a quality/task gate resolves it. |
| 3 | Pool-worker screen: 3 versus 5, task count held at 18 | On the selected chunk/cache and fixed CPU/PCIe/MTP/KV route, vary only `--pool-workers`; if 18 tasks is invalid/capped, choose one common representable count and show the source cap. Current official measurement only used workers 5. | Startup effective workers/tasks and participating host worker, request-local CPU/GPU/PCIe route counters; independent decode samples. Do not use lifetime/prefill-inclusive pool counters as request work. |
| 4 | CPU/PCIe service split: `--pcie-frac 0` versus source default (option omitted) | After selecting cache/workers, vary only the PCIe split. If the source default is not supported/admitted or resolves unexpectedly, use one documented nonzero fixed share as a separately labelled arm. Do not call it a prefill split. | Resolved `INFO pcie_frac`, actual CPU expert entries, PCIe expert entries/bytes if available, actual cache state and equal decode wall. Full output/quality gate; no inference from requested fraction only. |
| 5 | MTP/spec window, only if a common draft artifact is available | Current official runs contain no `--mtp`; first make explicit either `no MTP` (decode reference) or the exact shared MTP path/hash. For an enabled MTP screen, keep selected cache/workers/PCIe/KV fixed and compare spec 2 versus 4 (one optional 8 only with a quality reason). Leave prompt-lookup/suffix drafting and split/capture policy fixed. | INFO `spec`, `mtp_max`, actual proposed/accepted drafts, rejection counters, equal 256-output endpoint and quality checks. Sixteen generated tokens cannot qualify speculation. |
| 6 | Held-out 64K confirmation | Repeat only the selected setting and the same-source baseline; keep `--kv-resident 32768` for the main held-out comparison to expose the same streamed-KV mode. A separate 64K-resident arm is optional only if enough VRAM exists and is explicitly labeled as a KV-residency factor. | 65,536 exact fresh tokens, actual chunk progress to 65,535, `INFO` KV cells/mode, successful completion/normal close, free-memory/high-water, output/quality evidence. This validates a 64K prompt, not a 262,144-token input. |

This screen is staged, not a Cartesian product: prefill rows first; select a chunk; then cache; then worker count; then PCIe share; then MTP/spec. One-factor changes keep interactions interpretable. For source ranking, run the same baseline and chosen official recipe on Xe; the small setting sweep is principally within official v0.1.43 so the bounded test does not multiply every candidate across two compiler/runtime/source stacks. If the selected recipe is reported as “upstream tuned”, its chosen official configuration must independently beat the preregistered official baseline and pass the same held-out validation. A cross-engine result remains a matched-recipe engine comparison, not a parameter effect.

## Measurement and failure gates

1. **Safety/admission:** Main confirms the exact source/runtime/device route is allowed. Stop on host-USM contract failure, allocation failure, unsupported/fatal startup, first device fault/reset, timeout/hang, nonfinite output, incomplete completion, or changed model/source/binary during the sequence. Keep the original failure status; no retry to manufacture a pass.
2. **Effective route:** A row is invalid as a fixed-chunk measurement if `--short-read` routes 32K through windows, if the chunk was clamped or no batched PP increments appear, or if requested cache/worker/PCIe/spec/MTP/borrow differs from the recorded effective value. The historical `--short-read 65536` and `--prefill 8` row is excluded from batched-prefill ranking.
3. **Correctness/quality:** Preserve exact input IDs/hash and generated output IDs/logprobs. For routing/cache/MTP changes that alter outputs, retain the result but mark quality unresolved; do not select by speed without the agreed task-quality or teacher-forced comparison. Do not mistake “normal exit” or 16 matching tokens for full-model quality.
4. **Quiet speed:** For selection, unset `STRATA_TRACE`, stepped verification, loader/validation logs and event instrumentation; run no profiler. Keep diagnostic route/counter runs separate from the clean speed distribution. Use 256 generated tokens for decode. Report PP prompt speed, REUSED→DONE decode wall/tok/s, TTFT and full-request wall as separate metrics; never subtract overlapping timings.
5. **Replicates/order:** One clean fresh process per candidate is a screen, not a winner. Bracket candidate screens with the baseline in alternating order to reveal drift; retain every sample. Repeat a selected configuration in at least three independent fresh processes. If rank differences are inside process spread, report inconclusive instead of expanding a large search grid.
6. **Memory/context:** Record free VRAM before and after model/prompt-path setup, actual reserved/borrowed slots, maximum single allocation if available, host RAM, and any KV streaming. Keep max context 262,144 in every row; label 32K/64K prompts by actual input tokens. No selected chunk or READY context proves a full-context prompt or RESTORE.

## Evidence and limits

- Retained update artifacts read: `bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-pristine-builds-host-regression/UPDATE_RESULTS-v160.md`, `official-cache128-cache512-results-v160.json`, and `integrated-full32k-clean-results-v158.json`, read from allowed `git show` revisions `ad891233`/`5c00407d`.
- Current update summary read: `/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012/bench/results/2026-10-12-prefill-production-leaf-events/REPORT.md`, `MODEL_RESULTS.json`, and the supplied `report-registry-v166.json` (792 reports). No controller contents or private active run logs were consulted intentionally.
- Relevant prior audits: R352 official v0.1.42 B570 generation admission; R354 official long-prefill eligibility; R357 historical pristine search coverage; R358 official effective controls; R361 bounded historical search; R367 official independent parameter matrix; R282 CPU pool worker/task recipe; R162 Xe0.1.42 source safety/effective-control delta. These reports establish the current gates and controls; this report focuses on applying them to the latest retained measurements.
- Supplied source identities: official pristine v0.1.43 `7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d`; XeStrata pristine Xe0.1.42 `da3d426079019daa6e01388d03b0d94ae67070b7`. Parent's remote check states both release/main heads are unchanged since those measurements.

No setting winner is selected in R286. The retained official result is an instrumented verify-window diagnostic; the Xe number is a one-point batched diagnostic; neither supports the claim that upstream settings have been sufficiently optimized.
